Cambridge Dictionary names 'Human' its Word of the Year 2026

Cambridge Dictionary has selected 'human' as its Word of the Year for 2026. This choice comes amid the growing influence of artificial intelligence (AI) and its impact on discussions about human identity, creativity, and the relationship between people and machines. The dictionary noted that the meaning and use of the word have become increasingly significant in the age of AI chatbots, reflecting a heightened interest in defining what it means to be human today.
